foundation.description: Zeta (Zebra Design System) is the foundation. NMTK extends it with Command Blue primary, workbench-mode accents, and a shell token layer.

primitives.note: Source: zeta_flutter_theme-1.3.0/lib/src/generated/tokens/primitives.g.dart. Dark mode shade60 = primary. Light mode shade60 = primary. Do NOT use primitive values directly in production UI.

spacing.note: Source: Zeta spacing docs. 4px grid. Flutter: Zeta.of(context).spacing.*

radius.note: Source: Zeta radius docs. Flutter: Zeta.of(context).radius.*

typography.note: Zeta spec font is IBM Plex Sans. NMTK overrides to Space Grotesk for all UI chrome.

colors.note: NMTK brand overrides applied on top of Zeta via ZetaCustomTheme + NmtkShellTokens.

motion.name: status-pulse
motion.purpose: Status dot oscillation for degraded/error states only.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Shell adapts to compact layout below this width.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Wide desktop; utility panel always visible.

command-blue.usage: Primary actions, active navigation, command-mode chrome. Max 15% of any surface.

studio-violet.usage: neurocnl and Neurosim surfaces only. Never on shell, Neurohub, or instrument surfaces.

state-healthy.meaning: System or module operating normally. Exactly one meaning: never decorative.

state-live.meaning: Hardware actively connected, recording, or streaming.

display.purpose: Module-level headers and major surface titles. Used sparingly.

headline.purpose: Section headers within module surfaces and panel titles.

title.purpose: Card headers, workspace labels, group headers.

body.purpose: All readable content: descriptions, documentation, pipeline step text.

label.purpose: Status labels, metadata, chip text, navigation items. The workhorse at density.

mono.purpose: Code, CNL spec text, terminal output, numeric telemetry. Never for chrome.

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with command-blue border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: rgba(19,55,236,0.08); color: #1337EC; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(19,55,236,0.35); border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(19,55,236,0.18); } .ds-btn-outlined:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-outlined:disabled { opacity: 0.38; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview:
NMTK is a suite where complexity is accessible on demand. The user sees a calm, controlled workspace. Behind that surface, pipeline state, hardware diagnostics, and process telemetry are always one interaction away.

Foundation: Zeta (zeta_flutter ^1.4.5). NMTK custom theme id 'nmtk' sets Command Blue #1337EC as primary. Shell tokens (NmtkShellTokens) layer dark-navy and light-silver-blue surfaces on top. Three workbench modes carry distinct accents within one shared type and shape language.

Two symmetrical themes: dark navy and light silver-blue. Neither is the default; both are fully specified.

rules.name: Semantic Purity
rules.body: Status colors have one job each. They are never used for decoration, emphasis, or branding.

rules.name: Mode Palette
rules.body: Command blue, studio violet, and instrument cyan are applied only to their assigned modules. These assignments never cross.

rules.name: No-Oversize
rules.body: Hierarchy through weight contrast before scale. 28px is the ceiling.

rules.name: Mono Boundary
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for code, CNL text, and numeric telemetry. Never for chrome.

rules.name: Flat-By-Default
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. State changes produce tint shifts or border accents, not shadows.

rules.name: Border-Not-Shadow
rules.body: Cards use a 1px border to define their bounds. Do not add a shadow.

rules.name: No-Nested-Cards
rules.body: A card inside a card is always wrong.

rules.name: Inline-Over-Modal
rules.body: Modals are for blocking decisions only. Use utility panel or inline expansion first.

dos: Apply mode palettes strictly: command blue → shell + Neurohub; studio violet → neurocnl + Neurosim; instrument cyan/teal → Neurosense + Neurochip + Neurobench.
Use tonal depth (background steps) not shadows for surface hierarchy.
Achieve typographic hierarchy through Space Grotesk weight contrast (w400 vs w700) before size.
Map every status indicator to exactly one of the six semantic states.
Use ZetaButton, ZetaTextInput, ZetaAvatar, ZetaStatusLabel where the Zeta component fits.
Keep top app bar at 52px and workspace bar at 48px.
Use the pulsing status dot exclusively for degraded and error states.
donts: Use Zeta primitive swatches directly in production UI.
Add box shadows. Use tonal surface steps instead.
Use side-stripe borders (border-left/right > 1px as colored accent).
Use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Let NMTK feel like consumer SaaS, Arduino IDE, dark hacker terminal, SAP/Jira, ZBrush/Blender, or VS Code.
